findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection from CLI arguments
 * @description Executing commands with untrusted arguments from CLI
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-cli
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module CommandInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("argv").asSource()
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(SystemCommandExecution e).getCommand()
  }
}

module CommandInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionConfig>;
import CommandInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Command injection from $@", source.getNode(), "CLI arguments"

/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 *        external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall()
select call, "Call to eval or exec."
findings.hypothesis: The package might use eval or exec which can be dangerous if arguments are user-controlled.
Eval is used on command line arguments leading to code execution.

/**

 * @id py/cli-code-injection
 * @tags security

 *        external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module CliCodeInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(CodeExecution ce).getCode()
  }
}

module CliCodeInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CliCodeInjectionConfig>;
import CliCodeInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CliCodeInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CliCodeInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CliCodeInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Code injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: CLI arguments are unsafely passed to eval/exec leading to code injection.

 * @description Tracing where the argument to eval in tqdm/cli.py comes from
 * @kind problem

 * @id py/tqdm-cli-eval-source
 * @tags security

 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode evalCall, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  evalCall = API::builtin("eval").getACall() and
  evalCall.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "cli.py" and
  arg = evalCall.getArg(0)
select evalCall, "eval call with argument from " + arg.toString()
findings.hypothesis: The eval call in cli.py processes untrusted input from command line arguments.
